value: Backend DB (ScrumAgent-67j): SQLAlchemy 2.0 sync, one Base in app/database.py, models in app/models/ package. PORTABLE: prod=Cloud SQL Postgres (postgresql+psycopg), local/tests=SQLite — selected solely by settings.database_url. Conventions: string-UUID PKs (UUIDPKMixin) EXCEPT messages.id which is int autoincrement (guaranteed chat append-order; SQLite CURRENT_TIMESTAMP is second-granular). JSON via JSONType=JSON().with_variant(JSONB,'postgresql'). Enums via SAEnum(native_enum=False). TimestampMixin = DateTime(timezone=True) server_default now(). SQLite FK enforcement via PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON connect-event listener. Integration secrets encrypted at rest via EncryptedString TypeDecorator (Fernet, key derived from settings.secret_key, crypto.configure() at startup). Schema bootstrap = init_db()->create_all in FastAPI lifespan (no Alembic yet). User model kept from auth u2b (int PK + google_sub, email NOT unique) — conversations FK to it.

Slice 3 (meeting_participation) on personal @municorn: no Workspace admin = no domain-wide delegation = no Meet REST API transcripts. User has personal calendar and joins meetings in browser mode. Revisit calendar/meeting agent design later — likely browser-automation bot path instead of Meet REST API, or wait for corporate Workspace migration.

Local Docker daemon on macOS = Docker Desktop (reverted from Colima 2026-06-04, ScrumAgent-2s3 reversal). App at /Applications/Docker.app, context 'desktop-linux' (socket ~/.docker/run/docker.sock), ~/.docker/config.json has credsStore=desktop + currentContext=desktop-linux (Desktop writes these on launch). Start: open -a Docker. Colima FULLY removed: colima delete (VM), brew uninstall colima (+lima autoremoved), rm -rf ~/.colima, brew services stop colima, docker context rm colima. CLI docker/docker-compose/docker-buildx Homebrew formulae kept and work with Desktop. INSTALL CAVEAT: 'brew install --cask docker-desktop' fails in non-TTY/agent shells AND rolled back interactively here because its postflight runs 'sudo ln ... /usr/local/cli-plugins/docker-compose' and purges the whole install on sudo failure. Worked around by manual install from cached DMG (hdiutil attach ~/Library/Caches/Homebrew/downloads/*Docker.dmg -> cp -R Docker.app /Applications). Consequence: NOT brew-cask-tracked (brew list --cask won't show it, brew upgrade won't manage it); updates via Docker Desktop's built-in auto-updater. To make it brew-managed, user must run 'brew install --cask docker-desktop' in an interactive terminal and enter sudo password. Verified: docker run hello-world OK, compose v5.1.4, buildx v0.34.0-desktop.1.
